Estimate the slope of the trend line for the scatter plot above. Round your answer to the nearest $0.5.$
worked_solution:
First, let's draw an approximate trend line for our scatter plot:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13938989/assets/0575edf80f4a6f26c8f1002404ac04331d4c5d1f81b644021bc6284a6212338a.png)

It seems that the trend line passes through $({x}_{1},{y}_{1})≈(2,2)$ and $({x}_{2},{y}_{2})≈(6,8).$

Therefore, we estimate the slope $m$ of the line as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}m & ≈\frac{{y}_{2}-{y}_{1}}{{x}_{2}-{x}_{1}} \\  & =\frac{8-2}{6-2} \\  & =\frac{6}{4} \\  & =1.5\end{aligned}
$$
